usage.guide: Do not call this endpoint. The HTTPay gateway route for Mapbox geocoding (https://httpay.xyz/api/gateway/mapbox/geocoding/v5/mapbox.places) is dead: the x402 pre-flight returns 402 (payable) but the gateway returns HTTP 404 {"message":"Not Found"} after the USDC payment is settled, regardless of method or path shape. Two paid attempts (POST with a Mapbox batch-geocoding body, and GET with the canonical Mapbox /{query}.json forward-geocoding path) both 404'd, losing $0.001 each. Treat as broken — money is lost with no result returned.
